description: This file defines a base class for strategies that detect when a user starts speaking in a conversational or speech recognition system. It includes data structures for event parameters, base class initialization, event registration, and abstract methods for processing frames and managing strategy state.

classes.name: UserTurnStartedParams
classes.description: A data class encapsulating parameters for signaling the start of a user turn, indicating whether interruptions and user speaking frames are enabled.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class for user turn start detection strategies, providing event registration, configuration, and structure for subclasses to implement specific detection logic.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, enable_interruptions: bool = True, enable_user_speaking_frames: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the base user turn start strategy with options for enabling interruptions and user speaking frames, and registers relevant events.

methods.name: BaseTaskManager task_manager(self)
methods.description: Property getter for the task manager; raises an error if not properly set up.

methods.name: setup(self, task_manager: BaseTaskManager)
methods.description: Associates a task manager with the strategy instance.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the strategy to its initial state.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Abstract method intended to process incoming frames and determine if a user turn has started.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream or upstream, optionally specifying the direction.

methods.name: broadcast_frame(self, frame_cls: Type[Frame], **kwargs)
methods.description: Broadcasts a frame to other components by emitting an event with the frame class and parameters.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_started(self)
methods.description: Triggers the event signaling that a user turn has started, emitting relevant parameters.
